scope: Read-only local mainnet validation against public Horizon and Gateway.fm RPC. Agent-selected representative samples; no formal reviewer sign-off.

tolerances.integerStateAndVolume: Exact integer equality at aligned states/windows
tolerances.ui: Allow half the last displayed unit in addition to 2% for separately timed reads and valuation methods. USD references assume USDC = $1; Aquarius PYUSD = $1. These are documented test assumptions, not market-price assertions or reviewer approval.

observedUi.mapLabel: Top 100 holders of USDC as bubbles sized by their share of the supply

observedUi.scope: 500 classic, 75 Aquarius, 4 Soroswap. Other protocols are comparison-only.

limitations: Native browser checks were performed on desktop. Mobile interactions are covered by the passing synthetic Chromium suite.
The overview shortlist is 500 classic / 400 Soroban candidates; coverage is not claimed to be exhaustive chain TVL.
UI and independent reference reads were taken separately; header ledger is the live tip, not a guaranteed data snapshot marker.
The first overview HTTP fetch returned a history-unavailable state; subsequent native browser inspection rendered the 30-day history.
Soroswap trade totals count operations; multiple swaps in an operation can make the number smaller than the RPC swap-event count.
This capture checks the USDC snapshot reconstruction, not every asset or every ingestion record.

queries.holder-state-counts: SELECT 'trustlines' AS source,count() AS total,countIf(balance>0) AS positive,toString(sum(balance)) AS supply FROM state_trustlines WHERE asset='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN' UNION ALL SELECT 'sac' AS source,count() AS total,countIf(balance>0) AS positive,toString(sum(balance)) AS supply FROM state_sac_balances WHERE asset='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN'
queries.holder-snapshot: SELECT started_at,finished_at,ledger,closed_at,snapshot FROM state_copy_runs ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1
queries.aquarius-transfers: SELECT ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index,closed_at,asset,contract_id,toString(amount) AS amount FROM transfers_by_account WHERE account='CDMH535JSD224YXPET3B4SJOLXTQQ24GRSCWACGYBKSH2DKFJYWI7SUW' AND kind='transfer' AND ledger_sequence > 65563127-17280 AND ledger_sequence <= 65563127 ORDER BY ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index
queries.soroswap-transfers: SELECT ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index,closed_at,asset,contract_id,toString(amount) AS amount FROM transfers_by_account WHERE account='CATUJXDUO7SSSTAKSUV5YU6RSTB4B5AVIHQDV26QTCXOB46T6SLMWNMY' AND kind='transfer' AND ledger_sequence > 65563127-17280 AND ledger_sequence <= 65563127 ORDER BY ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index
queries.holder-claimable-supply: SELECT toString(sum(amount)) AS supply FROM state_claimable_balances WHERE asset='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN'
queries.holder-state-ranking: SELECT holder,toString(sum(balance)) AS amount FROM (SELECT account_id AS holder,toInt128(balance) AS balance FROM state_trustlines WHERE asset='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN' UNION ALL SELECT holder,balance FROM state_sac_balances WHERE asset='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN') GROUP BY holder HAVING sum(balance)>0 ORDER BY sum(balance) DESC,holder LIMIT 100
queries.classic-transfers: SELECT ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index,closed_at,asset,toString(amount) AS amount FROM transfers_by_account WHERE account='LCSGRVA5R2NY6PDSBFSRMCFXJN63PLEZKLOK4DG7ESDR2HM4PMAIQQUG' AND kind='transfer' AND ledger_sequence > 65563127-17280 AND ledger_sequence <= 65563127 ORDER BY ledger_sequence,tx_index,op_index
queries.holder-pool-supply: SELECT toString(sum(if(asset_a='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN',reserve_a,0)+if(asset_b='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN',reserve_b,0))) AS supply FROM state_liquidity_pools WHERE asset_a='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN' OR asset_b='USDC:GA5ZSEJYB37JRC5AVCIA5MOP4RHTM335X2KGX3IHOJAPP5RE34K4KZVN'
